scientific_question: Within the same original tagged animal, do temporal day/night GPS displacement and the geographical/solar-relative components of actual GPS travel differ between two supported site/year observation contexts? Which part is a route-bearing marginal rather than a joint Sun-moving direction relation?

parent.policy: Never reinterpret the 12/12 ERA5 SHA holds; no ERA5 is requested or used in this new GPS/astronomical route.

source_preflight: Verify provider original bitstream UUID, bytes and MD5. Before any new angle outcomes, replay ALL the original native taxa night/day GPS q and within-individual/year q~daylength source means and individual counts to 1e-12. Keep all native source holds.

sampling.time_selection: Original published one-fix-per-UTC-hour by timestamp only; original 0.5–2h valid straight-line GPS step, 0<speed<=60km/h, step endpoints and midpoint same solar date/daypart.
sampling.original_animal_q_days: Within original individual-year, >=10 days with >=3 DAY and >=3 NIGHT original GPS steps; daily q=log1p(median night GPS km/h) minus log1p(median day GPS km/h).
sampling.candidate_context: 1degree grid latitude/longitude × calendar year chosen from mean GPS segment midpoint of qualified original source q days; animal provides >=8 original q days within context; candidate context requires >=5 such distinct original animals and >=40 original q days.
sampling.two_context_selection: Evaluate ALL count-qualified original q contexts before viewing a new solar heading. Choose the distinct pair that maximizes number of ORIGINAL tagged animals with >=8 q days in both; tie-break by sum of minimum individual q-day counts across shared tags, total q days, then lexicographic private context key. Never select by direction, q magnitude, radiance or weather.
sampling.context_order: Rank 1/2 deterministic by descending q support number of distinct animals, descending q days, tie lexicographic. rank2-minus-rank1 is not before-after time, high-low irradiation or habitat intervention.
sampling.heading_days: Only original q-qualified animal-days with >=3 Sun-geometry-qualified daylight moving steps, solar altitude >=10 degrees at both original GPS interval endpoints and midpoint, displacement >=0.1km, time gap .5–2 hours, no interpolation.
sampling.tag_eligibility: At least 8 qualified q-days each with >=3 original solar/daylight moving intervals on each of the two selected contexts; at least two distinct 1h apparent solar clock blocks across all qualified steps.
individual_observables: mean daily q on the SAME original qualifying day subset
source geographical heading–solar marginal cos baseline equal-day sampling
joint circular component raw cos minus geographical marginal
mean geometric Sun altitude, mean apparent solar hour and mean modeled daylength on these q-days
sampling.within_source_paired_estimate: Same private original source tagged animal present and qualified in BOTH coverage-selected contexts. Compute per-tag rank2-minus-rank1 differences in q, raw cos/sin, marginal cos, joint covariance, solar elevation, apparent solar hour and daylength. Require >=5 paired source tags for group mean and 2000 fixed-seed original-tag bootstrap 95%. Do not treat different animals as paired or multiple gridyears as ecosystem replications.
sampling.inference: Use original tagged animal as the paired unit, one study DOI as ecosystem/source unit, source/native-taxon group summaries, full null/unsupported and source attrition. Without adequate cross-context overlap return PAIRED_TAG_UNAVAILABLE, never ecological zero.
sampling.ethics: Never publish original GPS file, exact coordinates, calendar/UTC timestamps, tag IDs, grid center identities, individual or animal-date coefficients. Publish source DOI, taxon, original support counts, grouped signed effects and privacy preserving aggregates only.

interpretation_limits: This route does not test shortwave radiant response; older ERA5 source version hold is preserved.
Sun position is deterministic from time and geography; raw solar-relative cosine can vary with geographic movement corridors without solar guidance.
Two selected contexts may differ in year, region, tag deployment, movement route and season; a paired difference does not establish causal environmental plasticity.
Same-tag cross-context difference in q is GPS step night/day displacement contrast, not true latent activity budget.
Preselecting by animal repeated q-day support is not random global population sampling or independent confirmation.
Do not claim climate mediation from Sun elevation or clock timing descriptive differences.
